activity_summary: With no morning rehearsal you stayed at the lodging while Mistress Ansell boiled Monday's ink from galls, copperas, and gum. Your horn was half full. It is twopence the horn when it wants filling. You told them Titus is at two, and that you would take the threepence board. The penny loaf was still a finger short. Gib was on the book. Gillis was already at his loom in Norton Folgate. The Candlemas packet stays until Thursday.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the morning for the desk and left the horn half full.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Boiled the ink and named the twopence, the threepence, and the short loaf.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Brought the ewer, moved the cat once, and asked which play it was.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Already gone to Norton Folgate. He did not speak.

entities.name: Richard Cowley
entities.context: Named by Alse, for the day he wore the gown. He was not in the house.

facets.activity: Stayed in while Monday's ink boiled

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Galls, copperas, and gum, boiled to the hour, and never a blot that came of the receipt.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: When it wants filling it is twopence the horn, the same as it was at Michaelmas.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: No rehearsal this morning. I am at the desk till one, and at the Cross Keys for two.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Threepence the meal whether you eat three bites or the trencher clean, and the penny loaf is still a finger short of the notch.
